"Global Villager uses Android VPN access to route internet traffic through an encrypted connection to your chosen server. The engine processes destination addresses and network traffic on this device and the VPN server forwards it.

Global mode routes other apps through the VPN. Smart mode sends recognized mainland-China sites directly; other destinations use the VPN. Direct destinations can see your original network IP.

Our account server receives authentication, a device identifier and service requests, and stores account, device, subscription and connection-service records to check access, device limits and trial eligibility. DNS queries travel through the VPN over HTTPS to Cloudflare and Google. These providers receive DNS queries and the VPN server IP; their privacy policies apply. Connectivity checks also contact Google and Cloudflare through the tunnel.

This app does not request location, contacts, microphone or advertising-ID access. A VPN cannot hide activity from the operating system or prevent tracking by signed-in websites.

Choose Agree and continue to request Android VPN access. Choosing Not now does not start a new connection."

Billing records may be retained where required by law; ask support to confirm the applicable retention before deletion."

"Going to the home screen, closing this screen or removing it from recent apps keeps the VPN running in the background. Use Disconnect in GV or the VPN notification to stop it.

To let phone Settings manage startup and shutdown, connect in GV once, then open system VPN settings, find Global Villager and enable Always-on VPN. While enabled, disconnect by turning it off in those settings. A restart restores the saved route and mode and rechecks account and device access.

For stronger system protection, you can also enable Block connections without VPN there. This may block local-network or direct-routing traffic; choose it according to your needs. Android reserves an exception for the VPN app’s connection/control traffic.

Some phones need background operation or unrestricted battery use allowed for GV. Force stop and the system’s Stop-app control stop the service. An app cannot override those system commands."
